Unilever România also engages in digital initiatives, including platforms for suppliers and customers, and is committed to sustainability and social responsibility.

description: Rompetrol is a Romanian energy company engaged in refining, petrochemicals, and retail operations, as well as providing well services in the upstream sector. Rompetrol also manages a supply chain and logistics network to support its operations and is committed to sustainability and decarbonization initiatives.

description: CBRE Romania is a Romanian company engaged in commercial real estate services and investment, providing integrated solutions such as investment, finance, value creation, planning, leasing, occupancy, design, building, property management, and portfolio management. The company serves clients in sectors including hotels, office, retail, industrial, logistics, and alternative property types, as well as data center services. CBRE Romania also offers transaction management, project management, design and build services, property rental, strategic consulting, property sales, mortgage services, and development services. The company is part of the CBRE Group, Inc., and is committed to sustainability, with a focus on minimizing environmental impact and promoting a sustainable future.

description: TIMAC AGRO S.R.L. is a French agricultural company engaged in the development, production, and distribution of plant nutrition, animal nutrition, and biostimulation solutions for farmers and agricultural producers. The company operates globally, with a presence in Europe, America, Asia, and Africa, and collaborates with scientific institutes and universities to advance its research and development activities. TIMAC AGRO also engages in sustainable agriculture practices and environmental responsibility.

OMV PETROM Marketing SRL is a Romanian company engaged in the natural gas and oil industry, operating in the Exploration & Production, Refining & Marketing, and Chemicals sectors. The company provides products and services such as gasoline, diesel, aviation fuel, bitumen, and chemical products, and manages fuel stations and gas storage facilities across multiple European countries. OMV also offers e-mobility solutions and is involved in sustainability initiatives, including circular economy solutions and carbon emission reduction.

description: Compania Națională de Căi Ferate ”CFR” – SA, known as Compania Națională de Căi Ferate CFR, is a Romanian state-owned company responsible for the management and maintenance of the national railway infrastructure. The company oversees both public and private railway networks, providing access to terminals and stations, and offers services such as ticket sales and information. It also manages railway modernization and infrastructure development projects, including European Union-funded initiatives, and is involved in public procurement processes. The company is a member of international railway organizations and is certified for its operations.

Noise Reduction and Environmental Protection Projects

description: Daimler Truck & Bus Romania S.R.L., DBA Mercedes-Benz Trucks & Buses Romania, is a Romanian company specialized in the distribution and servicing of Mercedes-Benz trucks and buses. It serves clients through a network of authorized service centers and a dedicated claims assistance team.

The company operates as a manufacturer and distributor, offering a range of vehicles and providing services such as vehicle financing, trade-in options, and maintenance contracts. Dacia also offers electric and mild hybrid vehicles, participates in government programs for environmentally friendly vehicles, and maintains a network of authorized dealers and an online platform for vehicle sales. The company is part of the Renault Commercial Group and is associated with Renault.

description: Fildas Trading SRL is a Romanian company engaged in the import, distribution, and retail of nutritional supplements, pharmaceuticals, dermatological cosmetics, and technical-medical products. The company operates as a wholesaler, distributor, and retailer, supplying pharmaceutical products to retail locations and pharmacies through a network of logistics centers and regional warehouses. Fildas Trading also manages a pharmacy network under the Catena brand and maintains a transport fleet for national distribution. The company is certified and serves clients across Romania.

C.N. Administratia Porturilor Maritime S.A. Constanta, known as Portul Constanta, is a Romanian public company that operates as a maritime and river port authority, managing and overseeing the ports of Constanta, Midia, Mangalia, and Tomis. The company provides port management, cargo handling, and related services, including dry bulk, container, general cargo, liquid bulk, and roll-on/roll-off operations. It also functions as a transit hub for agricultural products and serves as a free port. The company is part of the Romanian maritime port sector and is supported by European Union funds for the naval sector.

Cargo Ticket Booking and Reservation Services
Liquid Bulk Cargo Handling and Transshipment

description: Bunge Romania SRL, DBA Bunge Romania, is a Romanian company specialized in the wholesale supply of agricultural commodities, including grains, oilseeds, and biodiesel, serving the food and beverage sector. The company operates multiple facilities across Romania, providing crushing, refining, bottling, and biodiesel production services. Bunge Romania is ISO certified and holds additional certifications such as FSCC, KOSHER, EFISC, ISCC EU, and ISCC PLUS.

S.N.G.N. Romgaz S.A. is a Romanian public company engaged in the exploration, production, storage, and distribution of natural gas. The company also operates as an electricity producer and supplier, and provides technological transportation services. Romgaz is involved in geological exploration, well interventions, workovers, and special operations, and is a member of the European gas industry. The company is publicly traded on the Bucharest Stock Exchange and is majority owned by the Romanian State.

METRO Cash & Carry Romania SRL, known as METRO România, is a Romanian wholesale company that operates in the hospitality, restaurant, and catering sector, as well as serving independent retailers. The company supplies food and non-food products, including fresh and frozen produce, meat, dairy, beverages, and professional equipment and furniture. METRO România also provides digital services for retail operations and manages a central logistics platform for distribution and supply chain management. The company is involved in sustainability initiatives and is certified as a Top Employer in Romania and Europe.
core_offerings: Proprietary Brand Product Development and Distribution

description: The National Gas Transmission Company “TRANSGAZ” S.A. is a Romanian joint-stock company engaged in the technical operation and management of the national gas transmission system. The company is responsible for the transmission and dispatching of natural gas, as well as research and design activities related to natural gas infrastructure. It also undertakes complementary functions such as purchasing gas for technological use and balancing the national gas transmission system. Transgaz is involved in international gas pipeline projects and participates in research and development initiatives. The company is publicly traded on the Bucharest Stock Exchange and is certified for sustainability and environmental management.
core_offerings: Regulatory Compliance and Institutional Integrity Services

description: C.N. Poșta Română S.A. is a Romanian joint stock company engaged in providing universal postal services, including letter mail, parcel delivery, money transfer, and advertising services. The company also operates as a provider of business solutions, customs clearance, and electronic signature services. In addition to its core postal operations, Poșta Română is involved in public sector activities such as the sale of real estate and energy compensation services. The company serves the entire Romanian territory and is active in the postal organization and logistics sectors.

Prutul also exports vegetable oils and related products, including sunflower meal, sunflower husk pellets, and fatty acids, and manages a vegetable oil terminal at the Galati Commercial Harbor. The company is certified by organizations such as ISO, IFS, FSSC, FDA, Kosher, and Halal, and is affiliated with FOSFA and GAFTA.

Its operations are supported by technologies such as automatic plate scanning, automatic weigh-in stations, and RFID systems, with a primary emphasis on last-mile logistics and urban warehousing.

description: AQUA INVEST, known as AQUA CENTER, is a Romanian company engaged in the production and export of composite pipe products, including composite pipes, PVC pipes, and PVC fittings, serving the construction, water supply, and drainage sectors. description: EcoExpert Green Consulting S.R.L is a Romanian consulting company engaged in environmental, social, and governance (ESG) solutions. EcoExpert Green Consulting serves a diverse client base, including large enterprises, start-ups, and financial institutions, and offers modular ESG solutions to support companies in achieving sustainability objectives. The company also operates a platform for ESG reporting and maintains a network of partners and clients to facilitate access to sustainability tools and resources.
